latest_release.body:
## v12.4.0 (2026-11-06)

#### Features
* `platform-node`
  * [#18396](https://github.com/nestjs/nest/pull/18396) feat(node): let the node adapter set locals for every view ([@thekhegay](https://github.com/thekhegay))

#### Bug fixes
* `microservices`
  * [#18418](https://github.com/nestjs/nest/pull/18418) fix(microservices): ignore an mqtt server's own replies under wildcards ([@pavstev](https://github.com/pavstev))
  * [#18413](https://github.com/nestjs/nest/pull/18413) fix(microservices): reach handlers whose string pattern reads as json ([@pavstev](https://github.com/pavstev))
  * [#18392](https://github.com/nestjs/nest/pull/18392) fix(microservices): forward grpc call options on request streams ([@DenisCDev](https://github.com/DenisCDev))
  * [#18393](https://github.com/nestjs/nest/pull/18393) fix(microservices): await the mqtt close and reset the client state ([@hktitof](https://github.com/hktitof))
* `common`
  * [#18419](https://github.com/nestjs/nest/pull/18419) fix(common): keep the fields of grouped item errors in parse array pipe ([@pavstev](https://github.com/pavstev))
  * [#18402](https://github.com/nestjs/nest/pull/18402) fix(common): keep console logger from mutating the caller options ([@pavstev](https://github.com/pavstev))
* `platform-node`
  * [#18417](https://github.com/nestjs/nest/pull/18417) fix(node): omit the Content-Length of a redirect with a Transfer-Encoding ([@hktitof](https://github.com/hktitof))
  * [#18415](https://github.com/nestjs/nest/pull/18415) fix(node): give each route that shares a path shape its own params ([@pavstev](https://github.com/pavstev))
  * [#18372](https://github.com/nestjs/nest/pull/18372) fix(node): strip trailing slashes when resolving view names ([@saiyam-jain-dev](https://github.com/saiyam-jain-dev))
  * [#18403](https://github.com/nestjs/nest/pull/18403) fix(node): omit content-length when transfer-encoding is set ([@pavstev](https://github.com/pavstev))
  * [#18395](https://github.com/nestjs/nest/pull/18395) fix(node): render with eta, liquidjs and art-template ([@thekhegay](https://github.com/thekhegay))
  * [#18391](https://github.com/nestjs/nest/pull/18391) fix(node): add the charset to a content type the app sets ([@pavstev](https://github.com/pavstev))
* `platform-fastify`
  * [#18414](https://github.com/nestjs/nest/pull/18414) fix(fastify): answer 403 for a path the static plugin refuses ([@pavstev](https://github.com/pavstev))
* `core`, `testing`
  * [#18410](https://github.com/nestjs/nest/pull/18410) fix(core): apply a provider override whose value is undefined ([@pavstev](https://github.com/pavstev))
* `platform-express`, `platform-fastify`, `platform-node`
  * [#18400](https://github.com/nestjs/nest/pull/18400) fix(express,node,fastify): declare rxjs as a peer dependency ([@ryodine](https://github.com/ryodine))
* `core`
  * [#18407](https://github.com/nestjs/nest/pull/18407) fix(core): run middleware on subpaths next to an all-methods route ([@beyondwin](https://github.com/beyondwin))
  * [#18401](https://github.com/nestjs/nest/pull/18401) fix(core): cache external handler metadata per context type ([@kamilmysliwiec](https://github.com/kamilmysliwiec))

#### Enhancements
* `common`, `core`
  * [#18427](https://github.com/nestjs/nest/pull/18427) feat(core,common): send a web response or stream a handler returns ([@kamilmysliwiec](https://github.com/kamilmysliwiec))

#### Dependencies
* `platform-fastify`
  * [#18422](https://github.com/nestjs/nest/pull/18422) fix(deps): update dependency @fastify/cors to v11.4.1 ([@renovate[bot]](https://github.com/apps/renovate))


#### Committers: 8
- Abdellatif Anaflous ([@hktitof](https://github.com/hktitof))
- Denis Scarabelli ([@DenisCDev](https://github.com/DenisCDev))
- Kamil Mysliwiec ([@kamilmysliwiec](https://github.com/kamilmysliwiec))
- Roman Khegay ([@thekhegay](https://github.com/thekhegay))
- Ryan Johnson ([@ryodine](https://github.com/ryodine))
